draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and direct, referring to a part of the physical body
notes: Also used for the legs of furniture (e.g., das Tischbein) or trouser legs (das Hosenbein). In older idioms and anatomical compounds (such as das Schlüsselbein, collarbone), it retains an older meaning of 'bone', though the normal word for bone is der Knochen.

senses.definition: One of the lower limbs of a person or animal, used for standing and walking, or a vertical support of a piece of furniture.

examples.text: Sie hat sich beim Sport das Bein gebrochen.
examples.translation: She broke her leg while playing sports.
examples.emotion: concerned and empathetic, sharing bad news about an injury
